mapper.select: select distinct u.user_id from sys_user u join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.user_id join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where r.role_key = 'admin' and r.del_flag = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' order by u.user_id
select owner_user_id from jiedan_account_owner where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into jiedan_account_owner (user_id, owner_user_id, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{ownerUserId}, now()) on duplicate key update owner_user_id = values(owner_user_id)
mapper.select: select role_id from sys_role where role_key = #{roleKey} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select user_id from sys_user where user_name = #{userName} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select r.role_key from sys_user_role ur join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and r.del_flag = '0'

select count(*) from jiedan_account_owner a join sys_user cu on cu.user_id = a.user_id and cu.del_flag = '0' join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id = a.user_id join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id and r.role_key = 'customer' where a.owner_user_id = #{userId}
select count(*) from jiedan_order where owner_id = #{userId} and del_flag = 0
select nick_name from sys_user where user_id = #{userId}
